semantics.mask: Per-wheel floor contact >= the uphill toe with normal force >1 N at the observed endpoint.
semantics.primary: Nine observed endpoints (source and eight targets), eight adjacent comparisons.
semantics.secondary: Eight target endpoints, seven adjacent comparisons; the source-to-first-target switch is omitted.
semantics.partitions: all_four, stable_other and mask_changed are mutually exclusive within a basis. A switch counts a changed mask once per time interval even when multiple wheels change.
semantics.counts: Episode counts are distinct within each bin. Several overlapping windows from one episode can enter different bins.
semantics.rows: Zero-based source file rows, stop exclusive. A window starting at row j uses state[j], actions[j+1:j+9], states[j+1:j+9]. Its eight target-interval commands define the phase.
semantics.split: 89 mixed is the complete 91 fit set. Group future fit/dev splits by whole rollout/episode before windowing. Keep all histories from a validation reset together across parents and arms. The physical 90/93 panels are reserved for evaluation.
semantics.reset: Training starts at post-step tick 1. The zero-time actor observation is retained; a recorded float64 reset state45 is absent.
